mechanism.mechanism_of_action: Second-generation BTK inhibitor that covalently binds to BTK, inhibiting B-cell receptor signaling and preventing B-cell proliferation and survival

clinical.indications: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), mantle cell lymphoma (MCL), Waldenström's macroglobulinemia

market.market_position: Leading second-generation BTK inhibitor, approved in US and EU, blockbuster status [uncertain]
